best_idea: Start a copy's hard lifetime when it is built, run a separate empty-grace timer that stops when someone enters and restarts when the last person leaves, and key the copy to one owner so only one copy can be live per owner.
decision_why: The hard limit plus empty grace is row 23's despawn-on-empty with a grace timer; take the shape, use server ticks, start the hard limit at build, and give the build queue one pending slot so a new request cannot build out of turn.
acceptance: A server test asserts a second zone copy requested inside the 60 s window is queued and not built; a copy is freed 300 s after its last player leaves; a copy is freed 3600 s after it was built even when someone is inside.
